## Type

<!-- Tick one. Use the same type in the pull request title. -->

- [ ] `feat`: a new feature
- [ ] `fix`: a bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `refactor`: code change that does not change behaviour
- [ ] `ci`: GitHub Actions workflows
- [ ] `chore`: tooling, dependencies, other maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run check` passes on my computer
- [ ] French, Arabic and English texts updated (no text written directly in code)
- [ ] No personal data, real café content or secrets (not in code, tests, fixtures or screenshots)
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` (`Unreleased` section) updated
- [ ] UI change: screenshots below, including Arabic (right-to-left)
- [ ] Module change: module contract still complete and module version bumped ([module contract](https://github.com/WNSolutions/digimenu-tn/blob/main/docs/architecture/modules.md))
